title: computers.json
description: A digital archive of personal computers. Using free, accessible tools, it constructs high-fidelity 3D renders for anyone to use, creating an intimate space on the web that tells a story about each owner through detailed surface textures.

title: preserve.wardrobe
description: A fashion search engine, digital closet, and community home all in one. Rooted in curation rather than overconsumption, it’s a home for those who love fashion beyond aesthetics.

title: real american
description: A life-size invisible green card, symbolizing legal residency while still labeling its holder a “Resident Alien.” This term dehumanizes immigrants and reinforces the idea that they will never be seen as “true Americans.” Anyone can walk into the frame to reflect on, empathize with, and humanize immigrants in the US.

title: reminiscence
description: A reinterpretation of sentimental childhood items that were lost, based on three individual interviews. These recollections tell a story of objects used to communicate the intangible: memories and feelings.

title: dreamscape
description: A love letter to growing up as a neurodivergent girl, told through the language of lolita fashion—a J-fashion subculture defined by anti-consumerism, feminism, and radical self-expression.
